comparison.objective: Put dirty dishes in soapy water while excluding shears, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Object classification and placement around opaque liquid versus precision rigid-tool manipulation and repeated impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Dishes and utensils must be soaked while shears remain out; detailed numeric scoring and spill/damage thresholds are missing. Candidate requires quantified safe stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Hazard-aware sorting/placement does not overlap the candidate’s adjustment and dynamic-control objective.
